verdict.rationale: Docusaurus builds static HTML into a `build` directory that you can deploy to Vercel, GitHub Pages, Netlify, Render or Surge. Self-hosting on your own domain is therefore implied, but no evidence explicitly documents custom-domain setup or serving under a /docs subpath. missing for 10: explicit custom-domain configuration docs, documented subpath/base-URL hosting under an existing site, independent corroboration of either deployment pattern.
